content.short: 0x is an open-source protocol and DEX infrastructure for wallet-to-wallet trading of ERC-20 and ERC-723 tokens.
content.description: 0x, founded in 2017 by Will Warren, is among the oldest decentralized exchanges. It has raised about $109 million to date, including a $70 million Series B from investors such as Pantera Capital and Jump Crypto. The project provides open-source smart contracts that enable developers and businesses to build decentralized exchanges and trading protocols. These protocols support direct, non-custodial wallet-to-wallet trading of ERC-20 and ERC-723 tokens, while the 0x network uses nodes hosting an off-chain order book and the ZRX token to facilitate transactions.
